CHA!-vocado Goat Cheese Spread
By: Sabrina Ruggiero
Published: Thursday, July 3, 2014 - 7:02am

Ingredients




Ingredients:
Avocado, ripe, mashed				1
Goat cheese, whipped				½ cup
CHA! by Texas Pete®				1 Tbsp
Salt and pepper					To taste

Preparation

1 Preparation: 2 Place the ripe avocado into a small mixing bowl and mash it well with a potato masher or if you have a food processor, blend the avocado until it is smooth. 3 Place the mashed avocado into a mixing bowl and add the goat cheese, CHA! by Texas Pete® and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix together well. 4 Place in an airtight storage container and keep refrigerated until ready to use.

About

This bright and flavorful sandwich spread is made with a mixture of whipped goat cheese, mashed avocado, and CHA! By Texas Pete and goes great on grilled chicken sandwiches, cold cut sandwiches and just about any of your burger selections.
